title: A non-hereditary Pollyanna class that is not strongly Pollyanna
summary: Chudnovsky, Cook, Davies, and Oum introduced the notion of Pollyanna graph classes: a class $\mathcal{C}$ is Pollyanna if for every $χ$-bounded class $\mathcal{F}$, the intersection $\mathcal{C} \cap \mathcal{F}$ is polynomially $χ$-bounded. They further defined $\mathcal{C}$ to be strongly Pollyanna if it is $k$-strongly Pollyanna for some integer $k$, meaning that $\mathcal{C} \cap \mathcal{F}$ is polynomially $χ$-bounded for every $k$-good class $\mathcal{F}$. They asked whether there are Pollyanna graph classes that are not strongly Pollyanna. In this note we answer this question…
